chunks: And upon you be peace, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. As for what follows:

Know with certainty that you will not achieve your desire, nor will you exceed your destined life, and that you are on the track of those who were before you. Therefore, be humble in seeking, and be moderate in earning, for often seeking leads to deprivation; not every seeker is provided for, nor is every one who is moderate deprived. And honor yourself against every lowliness, even if it leads you to desires, for you will not get any return for your own respect which you spend. And do not be the slave of another, for Allah has made you free. And what is good in good that is achieved only through evil, and comfort that is achieved only through hardship.
ai.seo_question: What is the advice of Imam Ali on maintaining dignity while seeking wealth?
ai.summary: Delivered during the transitional period after the Battle of Siffin, this instruction reflects Imam Ali’s pragmatic wisdom in balancing spiritual integrity with worldly survival, urging Hasan to avoid the degradation of excessive ambition. The text emphasizes that true nobility lies in self-restraint rather than mere accumulation, warning that compromising one's honor for material gain is a poor exchange. This guidance underscores the Shia ethical principle of maintaining inner freedom and dignity even amidst political and economic uncertainty.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Know with certainty you cannot achieve your desire and exceed your destined life. You are on the track of those before you. Therefore, be humble in seeking and moderate in earning because often seeking leads to deprivation. Every seeker of livelihood does not get it, nor is everyone who is moderate in seeking deprived. Keep yourself away from every low thing even though they may take you to your desired aims, because you will not get any return for your own respect which you spend. Do not be the slave of others for Allah had made you free. There is no good in good which is achieved through evil and no good in comfort that is achieved through (disgracing) hardship.
